tool_schemas.name: search-models
tool_schemas.description: Searches Hugging Face Hub models matching the provided query and optional author/tags filters and returns a list of model summaries, capped by limit (results are not cursor-paginated; use limit to control size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query/author/tags are not strings or limit is not a positive integer, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Hub search service is unavailable or returns an unexpected response.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tool_schemas.name: get-model-info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns detailed metadata for a single Hub model identified by model_id (for example, card metadata, tags, and basic repo attributes). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if model_id is missing or not a string, NOT_FOUND if no model exists at that exact ID, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Hub cannot be reached or returns an invalid payload for the requested model.

tool_schemas.name: search-datasets
tool_schemas.description: Searches Hugging Face Hub datasets matching the provided query and optional author/tags filters and returns a list of dataset summaries, capped by limit (results are not cursor-paginated; use limit to control size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query/author/tags are not strings or limit is not a positive integer, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Hub search service is unavailable or returns an unexpected response.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tool_schemas.name: get-dataset-info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns detailed metadata for a single Hub dataset identified by dataset_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if dataset_id is missing or not a string, NOT_FOUND if no dataset exists at that exact ID, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Hub cannot be reached or returns an invalid payload for the requested dataset.

tool_schemas.name: search-spaces
tool_schemas.description: Searches Hugging Face Hub Spaces matching the provided query and optional author/tags/sdk filters and returns a list of Space summaries, capped by limit (results are not cursor-paginated; use limit to control size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query/author/tags/sdk are not strings or limit is not a positive integer, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Hub search service is unavailable or returns an unexpected response.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tool_schemas.name: get-space-info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns detailed metadata for a single Hub Space identified by space_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if space_id is missing or not a string, NOT_FOUND if no Space exists at that exact ID, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Hub cannot be reached or returns an invalid payload for the requested Space.

tool_schemas.name: get-paper-info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns metadata for a paper identified by arxiv_id as indexed by Hugging Face (for example, title/abstract and associated Hub references when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if arxiv_id is missing or not a string, NOT_FOUND if the paper is not present in the index for that arXiv ID, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the papers service cannot be reached or returns an invalid payload.

arxiv_id.description: The arXiv ID of the paper (e.g., '1810.04805')

tool_schemas.name: get-daily-papers
tool_schemas.description: Returns the curated Hugging Face Daily Papers edition for the given date (YYYY-MM-DD) or, if omitted, the latest available edition, including the list of papers for that day. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if date is provided but is not a string in YYYY-MM-DD format, NOT_FOUND if there is no edition for the requested date, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the daily papers service is unavailable or returns an unexpected response.

date.description: Edition date to fetch (YYYY-MM-DD); if omitted, returns the latest available edition

tool_schemas.name: search-collections
tool_schemas.description: Searches Hub collections by optional owner, item reference, and free-text query and returns a list of matching collection summaries, capped by limit (results are not cursor-paginated; use limit to control size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if owner/item/query are not strings or limit is not a positive integer, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Hub collections service is unavailable or returns an unexpected response.

query.description: Search term for titles and descriptions

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tool_schemas.name: get-collection-info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns detailed metadata for a single Hub collection identified by namespace and collection_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if namespace or collection_id is missing or not a string, NOT_FOUND if no collection exists for that namespace/ID pair, and RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds our per-client quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Hub collections service cannot be reached or returns an invalid payload.

namespace.description: The namespace of the collection (user or organization)

collection_id.description: The ID part of the collection

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_collection_info(namespace, collection_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0454000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0454000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    tool_name = "get-collection-info"
    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow()

    # ambient identity
    client_id = None
    if isinstance(_extra, dict):
        for k in ("client_id", "session_id", "caller_id"):
            v = _extra.get(k)
            if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
                client_id = v.strip()
                break
    if client_id is None:
        client_id = "public"

    # validation
    if not isinstance(namespace, str) or not namespace.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "namespace must be a non-empty string")
    if not isinstance(collection_id, str) or not collection_id.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "collection_id must be a non-empty string")
    namespace_t = namespace.strip()
    collection_id_t = collection_id.strip()
    if len(namespace_t) > 256 or len(collection_id_t) > 256:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "namespace and collection_id must not exceed 256 characters")

    # normalized cache key
    norm = json.dumps({"namespace": namespace_t, "collection_id": collection_id_t}, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    cache_key = hashlib.sha256((tool_name + "|" + norm).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    # log queued
    reqs = _load("hf_requests.json")
    req_id = f"hfr_{hashlib.sha1((str(time.time()) + os.urandom(8).hex()).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:16]}"
    req_row = {
        "id": req_id,
        "tool_name": tool_name,
        "client_id": client_id,
        "request_params": {"namespace": namespace, "collection_id": collection_id},
        "normalized_cache_key": cache_key,
        "status": "queued",
        "http_status_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "result_count": None,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "cache_hit": False,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    reqs.append(req_row)
    _save("hf_requests.json", reqs)

    # simple rate limit
    def _parse_dt(s):
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1]
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None
    window_s = 60
    max_per_window = 60 if client_id == "public" else 300
    count = 0
    for r in reqs:
        if r.get("client_id") != client_id:
            continue
        cdt = _parse_dt(r.get("created_at"))
        if cdt and (now_dt - cdt).total_seconds() <= window_s:
            count += 1
    if count > max_per_window:
        for r in reqs:
            if r.get("id") == req_id:
                r["status"] = "failed"
                r["error_message"] = "Rate limit exceeded"
                r["http_status_code"] = 429
                r["started_at"] = r["started_at"] or now
                r["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
                r["cache_hit"] = False
                r["updated_at"] = r["finished_at"]
                break
        _save("hf_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit exceeded", limit=max_per_window, window_seconds=window_s)

    # queued -> running
    started_at = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    for r in reqs:
        if r.get("id") == req_id:
            if r.get("status") != "queued":
                return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Request is not in queued state", request_id=req_id)
            r["status"] = "running"
            r["started_at"] = started_at
            r["updated_at"] = started_at
            r["cache_hit"] = False
            break
    _save("hf_requests.json", reqs)

    cols = _load("collections.json")

    # TTL handling: mark stale if old; attempt refresh would be upstream (offline) so serve stale if present
    ttl_seconds = 6 * 3600
    target = None
    for c in cols:
        if c.get("namespace") == namespace_t and c.get("collection_id") == collection_id_t and c.get("status") != "deleted":
            target = c
            break

    if target is None:
        finished_at = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        reqs = _load("hf_requests.json")
        for r in reqs:
            if r.get("id") == req_id:
                if r.get("status") != "running":
                    return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Request is not in running state", request_id=req_id)
                r["status"] = "failed"
                r["http_status_code"] = 404
                r["error_message"] = "Collection not found"
                r["finished_at"] = finished_at
                r["cache_hit"] = False
                r["updated_at"] = finished_at
                break
        _save("hf_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "No collection exists for that namespace and collection_id")

    changed = False
    ref = _parse_dt(target.get("refreshed_at"))
    if ref and (now_dt - ref).total_seconds() > ttl_seconds and target.get("status") == "active":
        target["status"] = "stale"
        target["updated_at"] = now
        changed = True

    if changed:
        # persist lifecycle change (active->stale is legal)
        _save("collections.json", cols)

    # Build response, resolving hub entity references if possible (without fabricating)
    entities = _load("hub_entities.json")
    entities_by_id = {e.get("id"): e for e in entities if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("id")}

    items_out = []
    items = target.get("items") if isinstance(target.get("items"), list) else []
    for it in items:
        if not isinstance(it, dict):
            continue
        out = dict(it)
        hid = it.get("hub_entity_id")
        if hid and hid in entities_by_id:
            e = entities_by_id[hid]
            out["hub_entity"] = {
                "id": e.get("id"),
                "entity_type": e.get("entity_type"),
                "repo_id": e.get("repo_id"),
                "author": e.get("author"),
                "name": e.get("name"),
                "description": e.get("description"),
                "tags": e.get("tags"),
                "sdk": e.get("sdk"),
                "downloads": e.get("downloads"),
                "likes": e.get("likes"),
                "last_modified_at": e.get("last_modified_at"),
                "status": e.get("status"),
                "refreshed_at": e.get("refreshed_at"),
            }
        items_out.append(out)

    finished_at = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)

    # running -> succeeded (served from cache; may be stale)
    reqs = _load("hf_requests.json")
    for r in reqs:
        if r.get("id") == req_id:
            if r.get("status") != "running":
                return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Request is not in running state", request_id=req_id)
            r["status"] = "succeeded"
            r["http_status_code"] = 200
            r["error_message"] = None
            r["result_count"] = None
            r["finished_at"] = finished_at
            r["cache_hit"] = True
            r["updated_at"] = finished_at
            break
    _save("hf_requests.json", reqs)

    return {
        "tool_name": tool_name,
        "request_id": req_id,
        "client_id": client_id,
        "cache_key": cache_key,
        "cache_hit": True,
        "latency_ms": latency_ms,
        "collection": {
            "id": target.get("id"),
            "namespace": target.get("namespace"),
            "collection_id": target.get("collection_id"),
            "owner": target.get("owner"),
            "title": target.get("title"),
            "description": target.get("description"),
            "items": items_out,
            "status": target.get("status"),
            "refreshed_at": target.get("refreshed_at"),
            "created_at": target.get("created_at"),
            "updated_at": target.get("updated_at"),
        }
    }

tool_schemas.name: get-auth-info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity as seen by this MCP server, including client_id, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses with UNAUTHENTICATED if no credentials are presented or they are invalid.

hf_token.description: Optional Hugging Face access token to identify the caller and apply Hub-authenticated quotas; when omitted, the server uses its default/public identity and public rate limits.

tool_schemas.name: list-hf-requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists logged tool invocations for the authenticated client, newest first, with optional filtering by tool_name and status. Returns request log rows including status and timing fields. Refuses with UNAUTHENTICATED if the caller cannot be identified.

hf_token.description: Optional Hugging Face access token; used to resolve the caller identity for per-client request history.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call; when provided, returns the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-hf-request-info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single request log entry by id, including its status, error_message (if any), and result_count. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the request belongs to a different client.

hf_token.description: Optional Hugging Face access token; used to resolve the caller identity for access control.

tool_schemas.name: refresh-hub-entity
tool_schemas.description: Forces a refresh of a cached Hub entity snapshot (model/dataset/space) from upstream and updates the stored record, transitioning status to active when successful. Returns the refreshed entity metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if entity_type is invalid or repo_id is missing, NOT_FOUND if the upstream repo does not exist, RATE_LIMITED when your request exceeds quota, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when upstream cannot be reached.

hf_token.description: Optional Hugging Face access token to use for upstream authenticated fetches (e.g., gated/private repos).

entity_type.description: The type of Hub entity to refresh.

force.description: When true, refresh even if the cached snapshot is not stale.

metadata.name: Hugging Face MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend powers an MCP server that searches and fetches detailed metadata about Hugging Face Hub resources (models, datasets, spaces), plus papers and curated daily paper lists, and Hub collections. It stores normalized snapshots of Hub entities and logs each tool call (queries + results) to sup
